title: Real-World Evidence Competitive Landscape in Japan
summary: Assessment of RWE service providers in Japan focused on secondary data analysis, covering local and global players and their positioning.

findings.market_structure: Japanese RWE market dominated by local specialists with deep expertise in Japanese healthcare databases, supplemented by global firms. Key differentiator: access to Japan-specific data sources.
findings.leading_providers: Local leaders include a provider with 150+ publications and 100% expert support acceptance, a health data company with 482 publications and largest claims database, and specialist HEOR consultancies.
findings.capability_gaps: KOL engagement offered by only 2 assessed providers. English-language information limited for Japanese firms. Few offer integrated technology platforms — most are consulting-led.
findings.crm_integration_relevance: RWE insights increasingly feed CRM workflows (treatment pattern data informing field medical guides). Implementation teams should understand local data landscape for Japan affiliate configurations.

source: Competitive landscape of RWE providers in Japan focused on secondary data analysis
